content_zh:
第69章 招兵买马-《华娱2008：从分手快乐开始》

“你是想在范兵兵手底下干一辈子。”

“还是想成为内地第一经纪人？”

这句话像一颗投入平静湖面的石子，在杨天真心头漾开层层涟漪。

“内地第一经纪人”这个称呼，带着难以抗拒的魔力，让她的呼吸不由得粗重了几分。

成为国内第一经纪人，是她一直以来的梦想。

和刚才义正言辞的拒绝不一样，这个女人已经心动。

“我今年22岁。”

魏沐不紧不慢地继续加码：“你就比我大一岁，你觉得，范兵兵会放心把核心经纪业务，交到你这样一个年轻人手里吗？”

稍作停顿，才缓缓道出关键。

“年龄是你最大的问题！！”

是啊，年少成名的故事固然动听。

但在论资排辈的娱乐圈里，资历尚浅的她，在范兵兵工作室确实很难越过穆小光那样的老人。

她还太嫩，根本没机会插手经纪业务。

“我和他们不一样，我是年轻人，你也是年轻人，可以一起拼......”

见对方有所意动，魏老板开始画饼。

画饼，他是专业的。

后世，很多人都说杨天真是国内第一流量经纪人，这个称号不过誉。

按照正常轨迹，她在今年加入范兵兵工作室，从这一年着手转变范兵兵在国内的形象。

“范爷”这个人设就是她亲手打造，还有“我不嫁豪门，我就是豪门”，也是她的手笔。

有一说一，这两个标签在圈内大佬看来就是个笑话。

但架不住唬人，老百姓愿意相信，这就够了！！

“怎么样？”

这下，轮到杨天真陷入沉默。

她没有立刻回答，而是端起面前那杯已经微凉的咖啡，送到唇边轻轻喝了一口。

刚才魏沐那一番话，信息量巨大，描绘的前景又极具诱惑力，让她感到口干舌燥。

如果今天换做普通艺人，杨天真二话不说就会走。

但这是魏沐，歌坛冉冉升起的新星。

他成立工作室，为了处理自己的经纪事务。

别看对方和她一样年轻，但人家有才华有潜力，还愿意相信自己。

这还不够吗？

沉吟良久，对方终于开口：“我回去考虑一下，给你答复。”

注意到她的眼神，魏沐知道稳了。

这女人是一个野心家，她愿意赌一把。

"You want to work under Fan Bingbing for the rest of your life."

“Or do you want to be the number one agent in the mainland?”

These words were like a pebble thrown into a calm lake, creating ripples in Yang Tianzhen's heart.

The title "Mainland's No. 1 Agent" had an irresistible magic power that made her breathe a little heavier.

It has always been her dream to become the number one agent in the country.

Unlike the righteous refusal just now, this woman is already moved.

"I am 22 years old."

Wei Mu continued to increase the stakes unhurriedly: "You are only one year older than me. Do you think Fan Bingbing will trust the core brokerage business in the hands of a young man like you?"

After a short pause, he slowly revealed the key point.

"Age is your biggest problem!!"

Yes, the story of becoming famous at a young age is certainly beautiful.

But in the entertainment industry that is based on seniority, it is really difficult for her, who is still relatively young, to surpass an old man like Mu Xiaoguang in Fan Bingbing Studio.

She is still too young and has no chance to get involved in the brokerage business.

"I am different from them. I am a young man and you are also a young man. We can work together..."

Seeing that the other party was interested, Boss Wei started to draw the cake.

Painting cakes, he is professional.

In later generations, many people said that Yang Tianzhen was the number one traffic agent in the country, and this title was not worthy of the reputation.

According to the normal track, she joined Fan Bingbing's studio this year and started to change Fan Bingbing's domestic image from this year.

The character "Master Fan" was created by her herself, and "I will not marry a wealthy family, I am a wealthy family" were also written by her.

To put it bluntly, these two labels are a joke to the big guys in the industry.

But if you can’t stand bluffing, people are willing to believe it, and that’s enough!!

"How's it going?"

This time, it was Yang Tianzhen's turn to fall silent.

She didn't answer immediately, but picked up the slightly cold cup of coffee in front of her, brought it to her lips and took a sip.

What Wei Mu said just now contained a huge amount of information and the prospect he described was extremely tempting, which made her mouth feel dry.

If he were an ordinary artist today, Yang Tianzhen would leave without saying a word.

But this is Wei Mu, a rising star in the music world.

He set up a studio to handle his own brokerage affairs.

Even though the other person is as young as her, she has talent and potential and is willing to believe in herself.

Isn't this enough?

After pondering for a long time, the other party finally said: "I will go back and think about it and give you an answer."

Noticing the look in her eyes, Wei Mu knew he was safe.

This woman is a careerist and she is willing to take a gamble.
